[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/27 (Sat) 10:21  
[FACT] User is testing blood sugar levels three times a day with the Accu-Chek Aviva Nano system.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for healthy breakfast recipes to help lower morning blood sugar readings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Managing blood sugar levels can be a challenge, and incorporating healthy breakfast recipes can make a difference.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided breakfast recipes:  
- Avocado Toast with Scrambled Eggs: 1 slice whole grain bread, 1/2 avocado, 2 scrambled eggs, salt and pepper.  
- Greek Yogurt Parfait with Berries and Nuts: 1 cup Greek yogurt, 1/2 cup mixed berries, 1 tablespoon chopped walnuts or almonds, 1 tablespoon chia seeds.  
- Oatmeal with Banana and Almond Butter: 1/2 cup rolled oats, 1/2 cup water or unsweetened almond milk, 1 ripe banana, 1 tablespoon almond butter.  
- Veggie Omelette with Spinach and Mushrooms: 2 eggs, 1/2 cup fresh spinach, 1/2 cup sliced mushrooms, salt and pepper.  
- Chia Seed Pudding with Coconut Milk and Berries: 1/2 cup chia seeds, 1 cup coconut milk, 1/4 cup mixed berries, 1 tablespoon honey or stevia (optional).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for breakfast: Monitor portions, choose whole grains, incorporate fiber-rich foods, and stay hydrated.
